messages.subject: Superscript - how?
parts:
Hi all,

This question has never been answered. In PLOTBUILDER, how does one conjure up a superscript?
I know how to do it in R code, but I want to do it in plotbuilder.
You can't enter in an expression as a label in PlotBuilder because Deducer simply escapes all the input as text.

I need it for units of measurement, so my workaround is to use an extended character ². But that's not really a solution.

Any help would be much appreciated.
Yes I can edit the call that Deducer generates, but that's not the point of this query.

thanks all.
